_comment: drupilot KNOWN-GOOD dev-toolchain matrix (the distributed reference lock), one cell per Drupal major family: exact versions installed and verified TOGETHER in a fresh DDEV test-bed (install, the install-toolchain.sh smoke test, run-rector.sh dry-run and apply on real modules, PHPStan and PHPCS). A test-bed uses the cell its installed core major names in config/targets/<major>.json (toolchain_cell); a project lock written by drupilot 0.9 keeps the legacy_v1 set until it is refreshed (install-toolchain.sh --source reference). Only a verified cell is pinned; an unverified one resolves from the config/defaults.json .packages ranges, with a warning. Never edit a version in by hand: only after verifying it the same way (docs/contributing/adr/0001-toolchain-pins.md).

12.src: docs/contributing/adr/0004-d12-bed.md (spike AR-42; re-verified on the current pre-release in M6)

Same as 0.21.2; drupal-rector 1.1.3 declares a conflict on rector >=2.6.2 for this reason. Verified with rector 2.6.2.
